class.name: NNBTSequenceStar
class.brief_description: A memory sequence that resumes at the child that failed instead of re-ticking the children that already succeeded.
class.description: This node type is a memory sequence (also known as a sequence star). It behaves like [NNBTSequence], but it remembers the current child index across a [code]FAILURE[/code]. The next run resumes at the failed child, so children that already succeeded are not ticked again. A [code]RUNNING[/code] child is resumed as usual. The node only returns [code]SUCCESS[/code] when every enabled child succeeded. That success resets the memory, so the next run starts at child 0 again. A [code]FAILURE[/code] is terminal for the current run, but the memory is kept for the next run. The memory (the stored child index) survives failed and interrupted runs, so a node that is ticked again after a failure or an interrupt continues at the stored child. It is cleared when the node succeeds, when it is explicitly reset, and when it is disabled. The inherited [member NNBTSequence.reactive] property takes precedence: when it is [code]true[/code], every tick starts at child 0 and the memory is unused.
